correctness.rationale: PASS: A simple cubic graph on 6 vertices has a 2-regular complement, either C6 or two disjoint triangles, yielding precisely the two networks. Exhaustive root-cluster counts for every 2^9 open-edge state and each of six roots were reconstructed independently (6144 rooted states). Differences by open edge cardinality j=3,4,5,6 are k4:(4,9,6,1), k5:(0,5,6,1), k6:(0,0,6,1), yielding exact positive tail differences. Moment tail-sum formulas and full variance polynomial Q were reproduced by integer polynomial arithmetic. Descartes transform (1+t)^12 Q(t/(1+t)) coefficients have exactly one sign change; Q(0)>0>Q(1), so exactly one crossing; numeric root ≈0.479245294778868 agrees.
